description: The open retry question (u39) gets an invented policy written out in words: 'retried three times with backoff', 'cleaned up after a day'. The old pattern only caught digits and 'exponential backoff'.

mutations.find: How failed processing is retried, and when a stuck photo is cleaned up, is not decided yet: no retry count or backoff is set.
mutations.replace: Failed processing is retried three times with backoff; a stuck photo is cleaned up after a day.
